verdict.rationale: Grok's own product docs say users can 'Talk to Grok hands-free with voice', so the product itself documents voice conversation. That is a single thin mention, and nothing documents real-time, natural, low-latency or interruptible two-way dialogue. The streaming Speech-to-Text API with a voice-activity gate is a developer building block, not the conversational capability itself, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of real-time, low-latency, natural back-and-forth voice conversation (interruption, turn-taking, voice output), plus independent or hands-on corroboration that voice mode works.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: Talk to Grok hands-free with voice.
